demoTour.title: New here? Take the demo tour
demoTour.introTestnet: Three steps through the whole product: get test USDC, fund a voucher, then follow it to the receipt.
demoTour.introMainnet: Three steps through the whole product: connect a wallet, fund a voucher, then follow it to the receipt.

steps.testUsdcBody: Connect a testnet wallet and draw demo USDC from the faucet — one top-up per wallet per day.
steps.connectBody: Connect a Stellar wallet that holds USDC. The app never sees your secret key; your wallet signs every transaction.
steps.fundBody: Pick a verified clinic and the service your family needs. The money is escrowed by the contract, not sent to the clinic yet.
steps.followBody: Every voucher has its own page with its on-chain history, receipt and the actions you can take. It is safe to share by link.

sep24Cashout.title: Local cash-out
sep24Cashout.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero with up to 7 decimal places.
sep24Cashout.popupBlocked: Allow pop-ups for this site to continue to the anchor.
sep24Cashout.noAnchor: No configured cash-out anchor currently serves {country}. Your clinic receives USDC on chain; local-currency withdrawal is a separate service provided by an anchor.
sep24Cashout.smartAccount: This wallet is a smart contract account. The configured anchors require SEP-10 authentication with a Stellar account address, so cash-out is not available from this wallet.
sep24Cashout.intro: Voucher settlement releases USDC to your Stellar wallet. Cash-out is a separate off-chain withdrawal through an anchor, with its own fees and processing time.
sep24Cashout.issuerUnsupported: An anchor is configured for {country}, but none accepts this deployment's USDC issuer. Ask the operator to configure an anchor for the exact token before withdrawing.
sep24Cashout.requirements: The anchor may require identity verification (KYC), additional documents, and acceptance of its own fees and terms. SCI Healthcare does not perform or guarantee the fiat payout.
sep24Cashout.statusFailed: Status refresh failed: {error}. The anchor may still be processing this withdrawal.
sep24Cashout.settlementNote: Cash-out does not change voucher or on-chain settlement status.

hints.register: Fill in the form below with the clinic name and country code.
hints.waitingVerification: An administrator must verify the clinic. This page updates when it happens.
hints.suspended: This clinic is suspended. Contact the administrator to restore it.
hints.listService: Add your first service and price below so funders can buy it.

hints.shareClinic: Share your clinic page so funders can find you. When a voucher arrives, mark the patient seen.
hints.waitingAttester: Care has been claimed. An independent attester confirms it before payment.
hints.waitingDisputeWindow: Care is confirmed. The payment releases once the dispute window closes.

hints.releasePayment: A confirmed voucher is ready below. Release the payment to receive the money.

split.amountHint: Gross amount before the protocol fee, between 0 and {amount}. The rest returns to the funder.
split.sum: The clinic net, the fee and the funder refund add up to the escrow of {amount}.

voucher.patientReferenceNote: The patient reference is an opaque hash. It cannot be turned back into a name or record number.
voucher.presentNote: Show this QR code upon arrival at the clinic. The desk can scan it instantly to look up and claim your voucher.
voucher.presentNotice: Present this number or QR code at the clinic reception desk.
voucher.ledgerNote: This voucher represents an escrowed commitment on the Stellar ledger. It contains no personally identifiable medical or identity records.
voucher.reportProblemIntro: Only the funder can open a dispute. If you are the patient, a relative, or anyone else who has noticed a problem with this voucher, open a report. It is prefilled with the public voucher number, status, service and clinic only — never the patient reference.

redirect.title: Move voucher #{id}

redirect.empty: No other clinic currently offers this service at or below {amount}.
redirect.confirmIntro: {clinic} will receive {price} and the voucher keeps its escrow of {amount}. Check the clinic and price before signing.

voucher.staffNoteNote: Kept on this device only. Not shared or backed up.

Disputed.patient: This voucher has an open inquiry and is paused.

Refunded.patient: This voucher was cancelled or refunded.
